$comment: OAC SCD Assignment (SCDA) authoring template, schema v0.9. Composed BY THE UPSTREAM MANAGEMENT CONTROLLER against the Definition the OAC published, and written to the OAC over PLDM for File Transfer (DSP0242) while the OAC is in Operational State O3, before OAC_PWR_EN is asserted. Replace every <placeholder>, delete every $comment key, delete every assignment the platform does not need to set, and minify before transfer. See OAC-SCD-Specification-v0.9.md Sections 8 and 9.

metadata.$comment: definition_revision is OPTIONAL and informational. Echo it verbatim from the Definition this Assignment was composed against if that Definition declared one; the OAC does not validate it and will not reject on a mismatch. Code 0x0D, which formerly reported such a mismatch, is retired to Reserved. Definition currency is established instead by the management controller reset model of Specification Section 6.4: OAC_MC_RDY deassertion is the signal to discard a cached Definition and begin again from retrieval. Do not cache a Definition across an OAC firmware update.
metadata.description: <free text -- human-readable summary; never affects OAC behavior>

assignments.$comment: THE ASSIGNMENT IS SPARSE. Include a key ONLY for a field the platform actually wants to set. An omitted field is not an error and is not a partial assignment -- it selects the declared default. An empty assignments object is valid and states that every declared default is accepted; that is a narrow case and will not suit most installations. Keys must exactly match an id declared in the Definition; an unknown key is a rejection (code 0x04). Values must match the declared type with no coercion, fall within declared min/max, and match an enumeration value exactly and case-sensitively. Never assign a value flagged sentinel_default (code 0x0A), and never use JSON null (code 0x0B). OMIT any field you do not recognize -- that is the mechanism by which vendor fields coexist with generic controllers, and it is always safe. DO reconcile the power fields before transfer: ocp.initial_power_max_w must not exceed ocp.max_power_w and ocp.initial_power_min_w must not exceed ocp.initial_power_max_w, and the OAC rejects a contradictory pair with code 0x10 rather than clamping. The values shown below are illustrative and are not defaults -- each must fall inside the min/max the target Definition declares for that field, and note that the power fields' min is the OAC's OPL-SET floor, so 0 is never a legal wattage even though it is a legal slot_id.
assignments.ocp.link_subdivision.<connector lowercas: <mode string declared by that field in the Definition>
assignments.pen.<IANA PEN>.<field_name>: <value declared by that field in the Definition>
